name: Molten gold
description: Animates the subject to transform into flowing molten gold.

prompt.default: The subject begins still, then proceeds to transform into flowing molten gold. Bright liquid metal runs and pools with warm highlights. High-speed studio cinematography, physically accurate reflections and particle motion, locked camera.
prompt.kling: The subject begins still, then proceeds to transform into flowing molten gold. Bright liquid metal runs and pools with warm highlights. Physically accurate motion, steady locked camera.
prompt.seedance: Locked camera, one continuous shot. The subject begins still, then proceeds to transform into flowing molten gold. Bright liquid metal runs and pools with warm highlights. Physically accurate motion.
prompt.veo: The subject begins still, then proceeds to transform into flowing molten gold. Bright liquid metal runs and pools with warm highlights. Cinematic lighting, realistic physics, locked camera.
prompt.wan: The subject begins still, then proceeds to transform into flowing molten gold. Bright liquid metal runs and pools with warm highlights. Locked camera, smooth realistic motion, high detail.
prompt.local-wan: The subject turns glowing gold and softens into flowing liquid metal. Thick golden streams run down its sides and gather in a bright reflective pool beneath it.
